history.summary: A 474 sqft 1BR at $1.436M ($3,030 PSF) in Zyon Grand, CDL/Mitsui's 706-unit integrated development directly connected to Havelock MRT (TEL), TOP ~2030. Strong sponsor, MRT-integrated, 84% sold on launch weekend, and the $3,030 PSF sits ~7% below the $3,249 project median — but it is a sub-500 sqft shoebox at a very high absolute PSF in a crowded River Valley new-launch market.
history.rating_rationale: Genuinely high-quality asset: CDL + Mitsui Fudosan sponsorship, direct basement link to Havelock MRT (TEL), retail + SA2 integration, and a strong 84% launch take-up, with this listing's $3,030 PSF ~7% under the $3,249 URA project median. The reservations for investment: $3,030 PSF is a steep absolute basis, this is a 474 sqft shoebox (narrowest resale niche), launch 1BR pricing was ~$2,738 PSF so $3,030 is a resale/sub-sale markup that compresses your entry margin, and capital is locked until ~2030 in a heavily-supplied River Valley new-launch pipeline. The integrated-MRT quality argues against Avoid, but the rich entry and shoebox format argue against Buy.
red_flags: $3,030 PSF is well above launch 1BR pricing (~$2,738) — buying at a sub-sale markup
474 sqft shoebox — narrowest resale and tenant niche
TOP only ~2030 — long capital lock-up; heavy River Valley new-launch supply competing

CDL/Mitsui Fudosan sponsorship; 84% sold launch weekend signals demand
